تختلسن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِسْنَ (taḵtalisna) /tax.ta.lis.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# تُخْتَلَسْنَ (tuḵtalasna) /tux.ta.las.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
